# v2.1.0b2

## 2026-11-07

Second opt-in 2.1 beta. Stable remains **2.0.0**.

### Fixes

- Ringer mute/unmute: wait for actual device confirmation before checking the
  new state, avoiding an early read that can restore the GUI's old mute flag.
  Block conflicting reads/writes during the transition and verify once at the
  deadline if the notification is missing. No extra idle polling or retry writes.
- Apply HA caller permissions to device services and retain the caller context
  for configured actions. Persist ring-capture reservations across restarts so
  failed, cancelled or concurrent attempts cannot reuse an unlock decision.
- Forward native-display callbacks without blocking the agent HTTP loop; reject
  concurrent actions and oversized requests instead of truncating them.
- Keep notification actions pending until completion and cancel them on unload.
  Recheck camera ownership during cleanup and serialize Home Call start/stop
  with status reconciliation so a starting call stays tracked.
- Preflight complete agent updates and roll back files on reported apply failure.
  This protection takes effect for updates performed by the new agent; it is
  not a power-loss recovery guarantee.
- Replace the optional Paramiko bootstrap client with AsyncSSH 2.24.1. Keep
  device-required legacy options scoped to explicit installation/recovery.
  Supported agent self-updates still use the agent API, without SSH.

### Update

1. In Marketplace, enable **Pre-release** for BTicino C300X. In HACS, open
   **Redownload**, enable beta versions and select **2.1.0b2**.
2. Update the integration and restart Home Assistant.
3. Complete the device-agent update Repair: this archive includes a rebuilt
   **2.1.0b2** agent. Integration-only installation does not fix device behavior.

Keep the existing integration entry. Follow any other Repairs offered when
upgrading from stable; the existing 2.1.0b1 display pages do not need reapplying
solely for these changes. See [update and beta guidance](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b2/docs/advanced-maintenance.md#beta-versions).

### Validation Scope

The ringer feedback race was reproduced and covered by local regression tests,
including missing, reordered and duplicate events. The corrected agent still
needs confirmation on affected devices; [#65](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/issues/65)
remains open for beta feedback.

The replacement SSH client passed local legacy-server transfer/error tests and
a real read-only C300X login. No full bootstrap installation was performed on
that device. The remaining legacy-crypto and host-identity limitations are
documented in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b2/SECURITY.md#legacy-ssh-001-rsasha-1-during-bootstrap).
